2610.09639.title: On-Policy Distillation Teaches New Skills but Not New Knowledge
2610.09639.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) strengthens language-model reasoning, yet whether students acquire new factual knowledge or compositional skill for multi-step reasoning remains unknown. We separate these capabilities using a controlled synthetic framework that measures the student's initial capabilities and independently controls the teacher's additional facts, compositional skill, or both. Across four models from three families, reverse-KL OPD reliably transfers compositional skill across unseen reasoning structures, but transfers minimal factual knowledge. Decoupling the distillation recipe reveals the source of this asymmetry: replacing reverse KL with forward KL restores factual transfer, whereas student rollouts specifically improve the execution of multi-step reasoning. Experiments on recent factual QA and competition mathematics show a similar asymmetry under reverse-KL OPD, yielding notable reasoning gains without factual memory expansion. Together, these results demonstrate that on-policy distillation does not expand a model's parametric knowledge, but instead teaches it to organize and compose the knowledge it already possesses.
2610.09639.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中加強了語言模型的推理能力，但學生是否獲得了新的事實知識或多步推理的組合技能仍然未知。我們使用一個受控的合成框架來區分這些能力，該框架測量學生的初始能力並獨立控制教師的附加事實、組合技能或兩者。 在來自三個家族的四個模型中，反向KL OPD可靠地在未見的推理結構中轉移組合技能，但轉移的事實知識非常有限。 解耦蒸餾配方揭示了這種不對稱的來源：用正向KL替換反向KL可以恢復事實轉移，而學生的展開則特別改善了多步推理的執行。 在最近的事實問答和競賽數學實驗中，反向KL OPD下顯示出類似的不對稱，產生顯著的推理增益而不擴展事實記憶。 總體而言，這些結果表明，政策蒸餾並不擴展模型的參數知識，而是教會它組織和組合它已經擁有的知識。
2610.09639.author: Yixuan Tang et.al.
